accepted.s: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP) is presently implemented under which component of Mission Shakti?
accepted.x: BBBP is implemented under Sambal, the safety component of Mission Shakti.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct umbrella mission by matching the scheme with its present administrative component.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the funding and geographical coverage of Beti Bachao Beti Padhao?
o: It is fully funded by the Centre and covers all districts.
It is jointly funded by the Centre and States and covers only selected districts.
It is funded through direct benefit transfers in rural districts only.
It is financed through district-level private contributions and covers aspirational districts only.
accepted.x: BBBP has 100% central funding and covers all districts.
accepted.tq: Test the pair of funding pattern and coverage together; avoid confusing central funding with shared funding.
accepted.sec: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao and girl-child schemes - objectives, ministries, Sukanya Samriddhi, Balika Samriddhi, Dhanalakshmi  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
With reference to Beti Bachao Beti Padhao, consider the following statements:
1. It is primarily a behaviour-change campaign.
2. It provides direct benefit transfers to every girl child.
3. It involves no asset creation.
4. District funds are linked to the Child Development Index relating to the Sex Ratio at Birth.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: BBBP is a behaviour-change campaign with no DBT and no asset creation. Its district funds are linked to the Sex Ratio at Birth through the relevant Child Development Index.
accepted.tq: Find the false policy-feature statement; direct transfers and asset creation are common traps in scheme questions.
accepted.sec: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao and girl-child schemes - objectives, ministries, Sukanya Samriddhi, Balika Samriddhi, Dhanalakshmi  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The Sex Ratio at Birth under the indicators cited for Beti Bachao Beti Padhao improved from 918 in 2014–15 to which figure in 2024–25?
accepted.x: The cited Sex Ratio at Birth increased from 918 in 2014–15 to 929 in 2024–25.
accepted.tq: Distinguish closely spaced numerical options by retaining both the base year and terminal year.
accepted.sec: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao and girl-child schemes - objectives, ministries, Sukanya Samriddhi, Balika Samriddhi, Dhanalakshmi  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The girls’ secondary Gross Enrolment Ratio cited in relation to Beti Bachao Beti Padhao increased from 75.51 per cent to:
accepted.x: The girls’ secondary GER rose from 75.51% to 80.2% between the cited periods.
accepted.tq: Use precise decimal figures to discriminate between nearby percentage values.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana:
1. It is associated with the Ministry of Finance.
2. A family may open accounts for at most two girls.
3. The annual deposit range is ₹250 to ₹1.5 lakh.
4. The account matures after 15 years.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The scheme is under the Ministry of Finance, permits accounts for at most two girls per family, and allows annual deposits from ₹250 to ₹1.5 lakh. It matures at 21 years, not 15 years.
accepted.tq: Separate the deposit period from the maturity period; the reversed time period is the trap.
accepted.sec: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao and girl-child schemes - objectives, ministries, Sukanya Samriddhi, Balika Samriddhi, Dhanalakshmi  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following is the correct combination concerning Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana as cited for the second quarter of FY 2026–27?

Interest rate 9.2%; more than 5.53 crore accounts
Interest rate 8.2%; more than 3.53 crore accounts
Interest rate 7.2%; more than 4.53 crore accounts
accepted.x: The cited interest rate is 8.2%, and the number of accounts is more than 4.53 crore.
accepted.tq: Match the interest figure with the corresponding account count rather than treating the values independently.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: Balika Samriddhi Yojana — micro-credit for poor women, 1993
Balika Samriddhi Yojana — conditional cash transfer piloted in 2008
Dhanalakshmi — cash grant at birth and scholarships for BPL girls, 1997
Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana — launched in 2015 under the Ministry of Finance
accepted.x: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana was launched in 2015 under the Ministry of Finance. Balika Samriddhi began in 1997 for BPL girls, while Dhanalakshmi was a 2008 conditional cash-transfer pilot.
accepted.tq: Use the scheme-year-objective triangle to detect swapped descriptions.
accepted.sec: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao and girl-child schemes - objectives, ministries, Sukanya Samriddhi, Balika Samriddhi, Dhanalakshmi  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (Scheme)
a. Balika Samriddhi Yojana
b. Dhanalakshmi
c. Beti Bachao Beti Padhao

d. Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana

List-II (Feature)
i. Behaviour-change campaign for survival and education of the girl child
ii. Conditional cash transfer linked with birth registration, immunisation and schooling

accepted.s: The Allahabad High Court held on 1 July 2026 that the age limits under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act apply:

To all citizens irrespective of religion
Only to persons below the age of 18 who reside in Uttar Pradesh

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about child-care infrastructure in Andhra Pradesh:
1. The State has 55,746 Anganwadi Centres.
2. These centres are distributed across 257 ICDS projects.
3. The projects include 200 rural, 33 urban and 24 tribal projects.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: Andhra Pradesh has 55,746 Anganwadi Centres in 257 ICDS projects, comprising 200 rural, 33 urban and 24 tribal projects.
accepted.tq: Verify the total and its internal classification; the component figures add up to the stated number of projects.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the Andhra Pradesh take-home ration package?
o: 2.5 kg Balamrutham, eggs and milk, with 200 ml milk in the richer tribal package
5 kg rice, pulses and oil, with no separate tribal provision
2.5 kg Balamrutham and fruit juice, with 100 ml milk in tribal areas
Only eggs and milk, without Balamrutham
accepted.x: The package includes 2.5 kg of Balamrutham, eggs and milk; the tribal package is richer and provides 200 ml of milk.
accepted.tq: Apply the service description to a field-level scenario and identify the enhanced tribal provision.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

o: Sakhi One Stop Centres — all 26 districts
accepted.x: Sakhi One Stop Centres are present in all 26 districts. The cited figures are 28 Shakti Sadans, 1,02,000 women reached by PMMVY, and Women Helpline 181 since 2016.
accepted.tq: Find the correctly matched administrative figure while rejecting altered counts and dates.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: According to the cited Andhra Pradesh data, which one of the following combinations is correct?
o: 12,692 cases through Sakhi OSCs; 38 Shakti Sadans; PMMVY reached 1,20,000 women
2,269 cases through Sakhi OSCs; 18 Shakti Sadans; PMMVY reached 1,02,000 women
22,692 cases through Sakhi OSCs; 28 Shakti Sadans; PMMVY reached 1,02,000 women
22,692 cases through Sakhi OSCs; 28 Shakti Sadans; PMMVY reached 2,02,000 women
accepted.x: The cited figures are 22,692 cases through Sakhi OSCs, 28 Shakti Sadans and 1,02,000 women reached under PMMVY.
accepted.tq: Read a multi-figure option as a single data cluster and reject options with altered digits.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements best reflects the criticism of the women and child welfare schemes cited?
o: They continue to focus on survival rather than full child development, and last-mile gaps remain in tribal and Rayalaseema hamlets.
They focus mainly on full child development and have no survival-oriented component.
They have eliminated all implementation gaps in tribal areas.
They are limited exclusively to urban women and children.
accepted.x: The criticism is that the schemes still emphasise survival rather than complete child development, while last-mile gaps persist in tribal and Rayalaseema hamlets.
accepted.tq: Choose the balanced evaluative statement; absolute claims such as “all” and “eliminated” are traps.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with the cited ‘first’ or unique feature?
o: BBBP — first launched at Varanasi; PMMVY — only nutrition scheme under NFSA
Tithi Bhojan — first began in Gujarat; PMMVY — only cash maternity benefit written into the NFSA
Poshan Maah — first began in Gajuwaka; PMMVY — only LPG subsidy under NFSA
Ujjawala — first began in Panipat; PMMVY — only SHG scheme under NFSA
accepted.x: Tithi Bhojan began in Gujarat, and PMMVY is identified as the only cash maternity benefit written into the National Food Security Act.
accepted.tq: Match each unique descriptor with the correct programme and avoid swapping launch locations or policy sectors.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events in chronological order:
A. Launch of Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
B. Launch of PM Ujjwala Yojana
C. Launch of Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
D. Launch of Dhanalakshmi pilot
accepted.x: Dhanalakshmi was piloted in 2008, BBBP and Sukanya Samriddhi were launched in 2015, and PM Ujjwala followed in 2016. Thus the order is D, A, C, B.
accepted.tq: Place the earliest and latest events first, then distinguish the two 2015 schemes by their launch details.
